title.zh: 【Open Standard 稳定币 OUSD 正式上线，由 Stripe 旗下 Bridge 发行】
title.en: 【Open Standard 稳定币 OUSD 正式上线，由 Stripe 旗下 Bridge 发行】

current_state.zh: Open Standard 的 OUSD/Open USD 稳定币已由 Stripe 旗下 Bridge 发行并上线，储备由 BlackRock、Lead Bank 和 BNY Mellon 持有，每月储备证明，1:1 免费铸造/赎回，通过 Mastercard、Stripe、Visa、Coinbase、Kraken 和 Uniswap 在 Base、Ethereum、Solana 和 Tempo 上分发；其中 Mastercard 路径经 BVNK，Visa 为有限测试版访问，Coinbase 计划于 10 月 1 日上线；公司由管理层运营，Coinbase、Mastercard、Shopify、Stripe 和 Visa 作为创始合作伙伴持有同等初始股权，并承诺投入超 10 亿美元流动性，接入合作伙伴已超 200 家。上线约 2 小时后全链流通供应量约 4.773 亿枚，储备覆盖率 100%（美国国债约 2.112 亿美元、现金约 2.661 亿美元），其中 Tempo 网络流通量约 4.342 亿枚、占比超九成，累计转账金额 5.339 亿美元。
current_state.en: Open Standard's OUSD/Open USD stablecoin is live, issued by Stripe-owned Bridge with reserves held at BlackRock, Lead Bank and BNY Mellon, monthly proof-of-reserves, free 1:1 mint/redeem, and distribution via Mastercard, Stripe, Visa, Coinbase, Kraken and Uniswap across Base, Ethereum, Solana and Tempo; Mastercard's route runs through BVNK, Visa offers limited beta access, and Coinbase is scheduled to follow on Oct. 1; the company is run by management with Coinbase, Mastercard, Shopify, Stripe and Visa as equal-equity founding partners that pledged over $1B for liquidity, and integration partners now exceed 200. Roughly two hours after launch, cross-chain circulating supply reached about 477.3M with 100% reserve coverage ($211.2M in US Treasuries, $266.1M in cash), with the Tempo network holding about 434.2M (over 90% of supply) and $533.9M in cumulative transfers.

updates.title_zh: Coinbase、Visa等五家公司成为Open Standard创始合作伙伴，并获相同比例初始股权
updates.title_en: Coinbase、Visa等五家公司成为Open Standard创始合作伙伴，并获相同比例初始股权
updates.what_changed_zh: Open Standard 的 CEO 披露了创始合作伙伴结构：Coinbase、Mastercard、Shopify、Stripe 和 Visa 各获得相同比例的初始股权，并承诺未来数月合计投入超过 10 亿美元为 OUSD 建立流动性；计划接入 OUSD 的合作伙伴从 6 月的 140 多家增至 200 多家，SBI Holdings、瑞银和 Jeeves 新加入。
updates.what_changed_en: Open Standard's CEO disclosed the founding-partner structure: Coinbase, Mastercard, Shopify, Stripe and Visa each received equal initial equity and pledged over $1B combined to build OUSD liquidity over coming months; integration partners grew from over 140 in June to over 200, with SBI Holdings, UBS and Jeeves newly joining.
